The Jazz Club at SOUTH

THE BEST LIVE JAZZ IN PHILADELPHIA

The Jazz Club at SOUTH is an intimate space with under 75 seats. It is the place to see your favorite Jazz artists up close.

Tickets for the Jazz Club may be purchased in quantities of one to six. We are sorry, but we are not able to accommodate larger parties.

The tickets you purchase for the performance reserve a table in the Jazz Club where you can dine before and during the show.

** PLEASE DO NOT MAKE A SEPARATE DINNER RESERVATION. ** 

Seating in the Jazz Club is staggered in the hour BEFORE the show begins. Once you select the desired performance and the showtime, you will be asked to select a seating time. We ask that you arrive promptly at that time. Late arrivals will be seated at the discretion of management.

The full dinner menu is available in the Jazz Club, as well as a broad array of cocktails, beer & wine.

A 20% service gratuity is added to all food and beverage checks in the Jazz Club.

During the show we ask that conversation be kept to a strict minimum. Immerse yourself in the experience and prepare to be delighted!

We look forward to seeing you soon.

Click on the images below to find out more about the artists performing, or to purchase tickets. Please note that all tickets are final sale, non-transferable and non-refundable.
